content: Stripe webhook handlers need the raw (unparsed) request body to verify the signature via stripe.webhooks.constructEvent - this works with Vercel's Node.js serverless runtime (disable Vercel's default body parsing / read raw stream). Edge runtime has historically had friction with raw-body access and some Node APIs Stripe's SDK relies on; Node.js runtime is the safer, better-documented choice for Stripe webhook endpoints specifically, even if other endpoints use Edge.
